name: Breadcrumb
description:
Where the current page sits in a hierarchy: a `<nav>` landmark around a trail of links.

  Breadcrumb do
    BreadcrumbList do
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: root_path) { "Home" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: projects_path) { "Projects" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { @project.name } }
    end
  end

Plain semantic parts with no state. `aria_label:` names the landmark ("Breadcrumb", translated).
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Breadcrumb(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

BreadcrumbEllipsis.description: A "…" for crumbs collapsed out of a long trail - usually a menu trigger's content. The dots are decorative; a screen-reader-only "More" (translated) names it.

BreadcrumbItem.description: One crumb's <li>: a BreadcrumbLink, an ellipsis, or a menu of collapsed crumbs.

BreadcrumbList.description: The ordered list of crumbs and separators; wraps on narrow screens.

BreadcrumbSeparator.description: The divider between crumbs: a chevron (flipped for RTL) unless given content. Decorative.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: Links before the last; the final crumb is `active` - plain text with aria-current="page".
examples.code:
phlex do
  Breadcrumb(**given(aria_label:)) do
    BreadcrumbList do
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "Home" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "Components" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { "Breadcrumb" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: With icons
examples.notes: An icon inside a link is sized and spaced next to the label.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Breadcrumb do
    BreadcrumbList do
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { Icon(:home); plain "Home" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { Icon(:folder); plain "Projects" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { Icon(:file_text); plain "Roadmap" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Custom separators
examples.notes: Give BreadcrumbSeparator content - a slash, a dot, an icon.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-5") do
    [ -> { plain "/" }, -> { span(class: "bg-foreground-muted size-0.75 rounded-full") } ].each do |mark|
      Breadcrumb do
        BreadcrumbList do
          BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "Home" } }
          BreadcrumbSeparator(&mark)
          BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "Docs" } }
          BreadcrumbSeparator(&mark)
          BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { "Breadcrumb" } }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Soft badges
examples.notes:
A block with an argument projects each crumb onto a soft Badge: idle crumbs stay muted,
brighten on hover, and the current one is filled.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Breadcrumb do
    BreadcrumbList do
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { |crumb| Badge(**crumb, variant: :soft) { Icon(:home, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Home" } } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { |crumb| Badge(**crumb, variant: :soft) { Icon(:components, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Library" } } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { |crumb| Badge(**crumb, variant: :soft) { Icon(:components, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Component" } } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Collapsed trail
examples.notes:
The middle crumbs collapse into a DropdownMenu whose trigger is a BreadcrumbEllipsis; a
disabled crumb is dimmed and skipped by Tab.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Breadcrumb do
    BreadcrumbList do
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "Home" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem do
        DropdownMenu do
          DropdownMenuTrigger(aria_label: "Show more", class: "text-foreground-muted hover:text-foreground-intense outline-ring hover:bg-background-muted data-popup-open:bg-background-muted data-popup-open:text-foreground-intense rounded-2xs flex size-6 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center transition-colors") do
            BreadcrumbEllipsis()
          end
          DropdownMenuContent do
            %w[ Documentation Components Themes ].each { |label| DropdownMenuLinkItem(href: "#!") { label } }
          end
        end
      end
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(disabled: true) { "Breadcrumb" } }
      BreadcrumbSeparator()
      BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { "Collapsed" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The chevrons point the reading direction.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl") do
    Breadcrumb(aria_label: "مسار التنقل") do
      BreadcrumbList do
        BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "الرئيسية" } }
        BreadcrumbSeparator()
        BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(href: "#!") { "المكونات" } }
        BreadcrumbSeparator()
        BreadcrumbItem { BreadcrumbLink(active: true) { "مسار التنقل" } }
      end
    end
  end
end
